title: 第1708章 太墟神鳌精魄第1707章 我独来独往惯了不喜欢约束
lines: “轻灵师姐有事不妨直说。”
看着欲言又止的轻灵，林铮还是说道。
“林师弟，我知道你不需要我手里的东西，但我和黑天师兄即将突破到大罗金仙境，我想先向你借两枚涅盘丹，日后我会还给你。”
要是换做之前，林铮肯定不会随意拿出涅盘丹。
而现在，情况却是完全不同。
首先，随着自己炼制一个月的丹药，所有精血全部炼制成丹药，可以这样说，他手里的涅盘丹堆积如山。
其次，他能看的出来，两人的确视自己为朋友，并且人家连借的话都说出来了，林铮肯定不会拒绝。
手里出现两枚丹药，说道：“这是五品涅盘丹，我可以向你承诺，等有朝一日，你们两人的修为要是能够突破到仙君境，我会每人再次送你们一枚六品涅盘丹。”
没有丝毫的怀疑，无法拒绝。
轻灵接过两枚丹药，说道：“谢字我就不多说了。”
“林师弟，原本我和黑天师兄商量过，想要邀请你进入青凰宫，但我们最终还是选择了放弃。”
“你知道为什么吗？”
林铮没有说话，不管是什么原因，对于他来说都是无所谓的事情，因为他从未想过要进入青凰宫修炼。
要是他安于现状的话，完全没有必要离开天阳仙域，一直留在剑古书院修炼即可。
“你的境界实在有些太低了，就算是能够顺利加入青凰宫，也只能是外门弟子，对于你来说没有任何的好处，必定会限制于你的修炼，没有好处，甚至会适得其反。”
林铮点点头，说道：“无妨，我也是真心话，我不愿意加入任何宗门。”
这是实话。
靠人不如靠己。
先是荒衍道院，接着便是剑古书院，都愿意庇护自己，但却是只限于自己在书院，只要自己离开书院，就不会再庇护。
这是他不愿意看到的结果。
随着林铮顺利拿出两枚丹药，的确是让轻灵感到意外，因为她也只是抱着试试的态度，却是没有想到，林铮真的愿意拿出来丹药。
走在船市上。
轻灵一直在给林铮说着关于葬古仙域的事情。
‘左边的摊位上，有你需要的东西’
脑海里突然响起沈烟鸢的元神传音，林铮显得很是惊讶，不过既然沈烟鸢感应到了，肯定是没有任何问题的。
立刻朝着左边的摊位而去，林铮元神传音问道：‘鸢姐，你所说的东西是哪一个。”
‘我要是没有感应错的话，这便是太墟神鳌的精魄，非常适合你的分身融合，要是你能得到，分身必定可以突破到大罗金仙境’
林铮还是第一次听说太墟神鳌。
似乎能够看出林铮心中所想，沈烟鸢说道：‘太墟神鳌，和太初祖鳌都是同等级别的超级存在，不过太墟神鳌的数量，要比太初祖鳌更少，这道精魄应该是封号仙帝’
听到此话的林铮显得很是惊讶不已，他当然不会怀疑沈烟鸢的话。
此时。
太初祖鳌的声音突然在脑海之中响起。
content_en:
"Senior Sister Qingling, you might as well tell me if you have something to say."
Looking at Qing Ling who was hesitant to speak, Lin Zheng still said.
"Junior Brother Lin, I know you don't need what I have in my hand, but Senior Brother Heitian and I are about to break through to the Great Luo Jin Fairyland. I want to borrow two Nirvana Pills from you first, and I will return them to you in the future."
If it were done before, Lin Zheng would definitely not take out the Nirvana Pill casually.
But now, the situation is completely different.
First of all, as he refined the elixir for a month, all the essence and blood were refined into elixirs. It can be said that the Nirvana elixirs in his hands were piled up like a mountain.
Secondly, he could see that the two of them really regarded themselves as friends, and they even said that they wanted to borrow money. Lin Zheng would definitely not refuse.
Two pills appeared in his hand and he said: "This is the fifth-grade Nirvana Pill. I can promise you that one day, if you two can break through to the Immortal King Realm, I will each give you a sixth-grade Nirvana Pill again."
There was no doubt that he could not refuse.
Qingling took the two elixirs and said, "I won't say any more words of thanks."
"Junior brother Lin, originally I discussed with senior brother Heitian and wanted to invite you into Qinghuang Palace, but we finally chose to give up."
"Do you know why?"
Lin Zheng didn't speak. No matter what the reason was, it didn't matter to him because he had never thought of entering Qinghuang Palace to practice.
If he is content with the status quo, there is no need to leave Tianyang Immortal Domain and just stay in Jiangu Academy to practice.
"Your level is really too low. Even if you can successfully join Qinghuang Palace, you can only be an outer disciple. It will not be of any benefit to you. It will definitely limit your cultivation. It will be of no benefit and may even be counterproductive."
Lin Zheng nodded and said: "It doesn't matter, I also tell the truth, I don't want to join any sect."
This is the truth.
It is better to rely on yourself than to rely on others.
First, Huangyan Taoist Academy, and then Jiangu Academy, were willing to protect him, but only when he was in the academy. As long as he left the academy, they would no longer protect him.
This is a result he doesn't want to see.
When Lin Zheng successfully took out two pills, Qing Ling was indeed surprised, because she only had the attitude of giving it a try, but she did not expect that Lin Zheng was really willing to take out the pills.
Walking around the boat market.
Qing Ling has been telling Lin Zheng about the Ancient Burial Immortal Realm.
‘The stall on the left has what you need’
Lin Zheng looked very surprised when Shen Yanyuan's soul transmission suddenly sounded in his mind, but since Shen Yanyuan sensed it, there must be no problem.
Immediately heading towards the stall on the left, Lin Zheng Yuanshen sent a message and asked: 'Sister Yuan, which thing are you talking about? "
‘If I’m not mistaken, this is the essence of Tai Xu Shen Ao, which is very suitable for your clone fusion. If you can get it, your clone will definitely be able to break through to the Great Luo Jin Fairyland.’
This is the first time Lin Zheng has heard of Taixu Shen'ao.
As if he could see what Lin Zheng was thinking, Shen Yanyuan said: 'Tai Xu Shen Ao and Tai Chu Zu Ao are both super beings of the same level, but the number of Tai Xu Shen Ao is less than Tai Chu Zu Ao. This spirit should be the titled Immortal Emperor.'
Lin Zheng looked very surprised when he heard this. Of course he would not doubt Shen Yanyuan's words.
At this time.
Taichu Zuao's voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
title_en: Chapter 1708: Taixu Divine Ao Spirit Chapter 1707: I am used to being a loner and don’t like restraint
